CRITICAL rule: the units tile the axis with no gap and no overlap -- each row's TO value equals the NEXT row's FROM value (they share the same boundary age). In particular row 3's TO value equals row 4's FROM value. Render it as a slightly warm off-white printed sheet with alternating faint grey shaded rows (zebra striping), a coloured header band and rounded panel corners, like a modern designed template, viewed straight-on.
